column1: # Game profile of Sea of Stars (Switch, update 2.0.59001 = v786432). Plays on the Mac
# Unity 2021.3.25f1 (IL2CPP) with Wwise, SDK 16.2.0 (its sdk is Super Mario Bros. Wonder 1.0.0's build); subsdk0 is the movie module (the cinematics are MP4s in StreamingAssets).
# The shaders are Unity's Shader and ComputeShader objects in the player's serialized files and the 1,126 bundles in StreamingAssets, read by unityfs.py (3,887 of the 3,898; 11 are the player's
# GLSLC outputs in main); no run met a shader missing from the map.
# The game asks for present interval 1 and runs at 60 fps as on the Switch

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)

# PEANUTS: add v0 (1.0.45861) and v983040 (3.0.60151) alongside upstream v786432 (2.0.59001). The shader tables are the v0 + v983040 union (v786432 shares the exact 3,898 keys of v983040); shader_optional.tsv lists the 1,543 v0-only keys.
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk0 = NintendoSDK_movie)
# The NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource, so IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is true: nninitStartup (main+0x8b66a0) hands application pool − used memory to StandardAllocator as one
# address region and never calls SetMemoryHeapSize. The sdk build takes the node area cut and the 2 MB region alignment of SDK 20 (dm/tools/sdk_patches.py). The 5 GB block of Ace Attorney
# Investigations Collection (256 MB in front + 4.375 GB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 128 MB heap region) with a 1.5 GB pool: StandardAllocator reserves 1.44 GB and commits about
# 0.7 GB in the prologue (measured with a 64 GB alias region); Unity's own regions hold about 1.15 GB more. With the hardware pool (3.2 GB) Unity got no region within 6 minutes
# (a write at NULL + 0x3fffe0); with the 1.5 GB pool and the cut the alias region's high-water mark stays at +3.0 GB over 20 minutes, 2.6 GB of it in live regions

# PEANUTS begin: 16 GB alias region (mem_alias 0x400000000), 2 GB Horizon stack region (mem_stack 0x80000000), 18.375 GB reserve (mem_reserve 0x498000000), and hardware pool (app_pool 0xCD500000, 3.285 GB).
# On Android: (1) app_pool 0x60000000 crashed at cutscene transition (1.43 GB mapped, MapPhysicalMemory ResultLimitReached -> SEGV_ACCERR main+0x48d0a0);
# (2) app_pool 0xCD500000 with 4.375 GB mem_alias caused StandardAllocator (3.14 GB) to exhaust alias VA at +4.25 GB (SEGV_MAPERR addr=0x3fffe0 main+0x48d0a0);
# (3) 16 GB mem_alias got past the cutscene, scripted battle, town, and second cutscene, then aborted exiting town at 450 s (`nn::diag abort: Result 0, call site sdk+0x136578`,
#     `MapAliasStack` -> `StackGuardManager::MapAtRandomAddress`): 47 live stacks (113 MiB, 10 of them 8 MB) left no contiguous 8 MB+guard slot in the 256 MB stack region (`mem_stack 0x10000000`).
# Horizon's 39-bit stack region is 2 GB (`0x80000000`, zero RAM overhead on Android via MAP_NORESERVE); mem_reserve 0x498000000 = 256 MB front + 16 GB alias + 2 GB stack + 128 MB heap.
# PEANUTS begin: prefer installed Turnip on Qualcomm drivers before 512.800 (driverID 8, major 512, minor < 800).
# Measured on OnePlus 13R (Adreno 750, Qualcomm 512.762.41 / 0x802fa029): broken graphics from boot and VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST (-4) at submission 1039/1076
# (including with DM_VK_ZSHARE=0; DM_VK_FD_ALIAS=0 is refused since placed maps are unsupported). Turnip T30 plays 20+ minutes at 60 fps; see README.md.
# PEANUTS: Qualcomm's driver before 512.800 (512.762.41, Adreno 750): the overworld whited out in pixel shader 4dcce9647508810e (SOS/VFX/MistMesh-V4) with push
# descriptors on (#888, #907; README.md, not yet checked on a device by us). Only draw / compute layouts go off push descriptors there; the recommend row above
# still prefers Turnip. DM_VK_PUSH_DESC still overrides it
# ---- Shader split (shader_split.py; Unity Shader objects, read by unityfs.py) ----
# everything is under Data/: the player's serialized files and the StreamingAssets bundles
